newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds eye 114-08, 114-16 at a stretch.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds eye 114-08, 114-16 at a stretch.

text.p: September T-bond futures will continue to retrace recent declines on Monday but will find it difficult to progress much beyond the 114-16 area, technical analysts said.
"The market still has upside potential to 114-08/16," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London.
He noted price resistance here as well as the 50 percent retracement of the recent slide from the 116-31 high, coming in around 114-15.
T-bonds were quoted at 113-30, up 10/32 in automated trade, continuing to claw steadily back from the recent 111-31 low on August 18.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell here, also saw the December contract pushing a little higher but it would likely be capped in the 114-22 area.
Sneddon said September T-bonds were likely to fail around 114-16 but a push through would give it strength for an attack on the 115-06,09 area. The contract hit a high of 115-06 on August 7.
Price support this session surfaces at 113-25,28 he said.
Lows around 112-25 at the end of last week would also offer a buffer.
December Eurodollars were quoted at 94.165, up 0.030.
